hook.text: Orpheus played music so beautiful that rivers stopped flowing and stones wept to hear him.

buildup.text: When his wife Eurydice died from a snakebite, Orpheus walked into the underworld to bring her back.

discovery.text: His music moved Hades himself, who agreed to release Eurydice on one condition.

twist.text: Orpheus must not look back at her until they reached the surface. Just steps from sunlight, he turned.

climax.text: Eurydice vanished forever. He spent his remaining days singing songs of unbearable loss.

punchline.text: Love brought him to hell. Doubt kept him there.

quiz.question: What was the one condition Hades set for Eurydice's release?
options: Orpheus had to play music without stopping
Orpheus must not look back at her until reaching the surface
Orpheus had to defeat Cerberus in a contest
